name: CoreWeave Marble NC

timeline.event: Core Scientific announced that CoreWeave would receive about 70 MW of HPC infrastructure from 100 MW of owned infrastructure. Site modifications were expected to begin in H2 2024.
The site has been energized. Two of three data halls had been delivered at 37 billable MW, supporting about 15000 Grace Blackwell GPUs. The third hall was still in commissioning.
Satellite imagery shows the main data hall and southern utility yard substantially complete. No new public MW disclosure, so this keeps the March 2026 public 36 MW state.
Core Scientific said Marble was fully handed over to CoreWeave with about 65 MW of billable customer power online.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: CoreWeave Marble NC: current power 65 MW; owner CoreWeave.

explain: CoreWeave Marble NC is an operating AI data center in Marble, NC, owned by coreweave. Epoch AI estimates it draws 65 MW today and 91 MW when finished.
